name: Planet Technology Corporation
summary: Planet Technology Corporation, established in 1993 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a global provider of IP-based networking products and solutions. The company caters to small-to-medium-sized businesses, large enterprises, and diverse network infrastructures across Europe, the United States, Asia, and other international markets. Their comprehensive product portfolio spans core local area network (LAN) Ethernet switches and accessories, alongside robust industrial Ethernet devices such as switches, routers, media converters, fiber bypass switches, and DIN rail power supplies. They also provide industrial automation solutions, including serial device servers, protocol gateways, and EtherCAT slave I/O modules. Further offerings encompass diverse media conversion technologies—ranging from converter chassis and various media converters to Ethernet extenders, optical fiber bypass switches, SFP/SFP+/QSFP transceivers, and video optical transmission systems—as well as broadband communication products. A significant portion of their catalog is dedicated to Power over Ethernet (PoE) solutions, featuring PoE switches, injectors, splitters, media converters, extenders, power over coaxial options, PoE gateways, renewable energy PoE systems, and PoE network interface cards. Moreover, Planet Technology supplies wireless LAN solutions, including access point controllers, routers, indoor/outdoor access points/bridges, and associated antenna and cable accessories. Their IP telephony range covers IP PBX systems, VoIP gateways, phones, and IP intercom/paging systems. For security and surveillance, they offer IP surveillance devices like video recorder servers, cameras, extended surveillance tools, mobile device software, and a variety of mounting, PoE, and media converter accessories. Finally, the company's repertoire extends to home automation products (control gateways, IP intercoms, Z-Wave devices), various network peripherals, network security solutions (VPN firewalls/gateways, gigabit/VPN routers), and advanced network management systems.
